# The swapone pack

*SwapOne* · version 1.0.0 · code `SWPO`

## What it is

SwapOne is an OTC swaps system (mocked here: a synthetic look-alike, UPPER_SNAKE names like Endur, a swap as a pay leg and a receive leg, epoch-millisecond update times).
The data is **mocked**: a synthetic look-alike written by `tools/samplegen/src_swapone.py` (never real data, banks or counterparties), a few hundred trades over sixty business days in the system's own native style, with no positions and no scenario P&L, so the VaR does not move.

This pack is one source of the canonical `trade` kind: its rows carry `SOURCE_SYSTEM = SWAPONE`. It is a pack of the `trading-systems` module that
extends `trading`; switch it on or off in Admin -> Artifacts (the pack is the switch).

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on the packs `trading`.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trade-swapone` | `delta` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `trade-swapone-live` | `kafka` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_STREAM_SWAPONE:false}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_STALE_AFTER`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_SWAPONE`, `DRISHTI_SWAPONE_TOPIC`.
